A.notes: A has a clear terminal-to-explanation idea and the product demo is integrated well into the story; the scroll strip shows a meaningful sequence where output develops into the ranked explanation. Typography and visual tone fit the audience, but the giant dead space, orphaned "or," and broken-looking mobile/full-page composition are major craft penalties. Reduced-motion and keyboard basics appear covered from the checks.

B.notes: B is clean, readable, and complete, with strong basic structure and solid responsive execution. It feels much closer to a polished default SaaS template, and the scroll-frame strip shows little motion story beyond normal section progression, so Motion and Originality stay low. Accessibility/performance evidence is strong and the implementation looks dependable.

raw.why: A is less polished, but it expresses a stronger product idea with a more purposeful demo and more concept-driven motion than B’s cleaner but more generic execution.
